description_zh: 单向五车道城市干道（Harrison Street），同向至少5条车道，无对向车道，中心线无实际意义（默认 broken）；事故为同向车道间变道刮擦，非路口。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomous mode was traveling in lane 4 on southwest-bound Harrison Street near Columbia Square in San Francisco.
a passenger car (Vehicle 2), traveling in the same direction ahead of the Zoox vehicle in the right adjacent lane (lane 5)
Vehicle 2 then swerved left into lane 4 across the path of the Zoox vehicle
evidence.reason: 道路为直线城市干道，非交叉口；同向出现 lane 4 与 lane 5（右相邻），推断为单向至少5车道，故 forward=5, backward=0；Harrison Street 为城市干道，type=townArterial；单向无中心线实际意义，默认 broken。
